premises.scope: invertible indefinite physical pair plus any original-coordinate cut of its exact Schur residual with positive first-compound crossing energy

new_claim.statement: For an invertible indefinite physical pair H, with kappa=sigma_min(A[H,H]) and W_H^(2)=sum_{i!=j} det A[H union {i},H union {j}]^2, ||p_(X^TAX)||_infinity <= 2^(25/8)*exp(1/8)*sqrt(Gamma(1/4))*(kappa^2 W_H^(2))^(-1/8).

exact_structural_identity: If S is the pair-Schur complement and D=|det B|, then W_H^(2)=D^2 sum_{i!=j} S_ij^2 and some physical cut U|V has ||S[U,V]||_F^2 >= W_H^(2)/(4D^2); insertion into the first-compound/pair-log receiver cancels D exactly.
explicit_family: A_m=[[B,L_m],[L_m^T,2I_m-(4/m)J_m+L_m^T B^-1 L_m]], B=[[1,3],[3,1]], L_m=(100m)^-1[[1,...,1],[2,...,2]], m>=3. Fully dense; all |eigenvalues|>1.987; every local overlap-two determinant is 32/m but W_H^(2)=1024(m-1)/m; bound tends to 6.65504644481997.
next_step: Use Delta_3^(2)=sum_H W_H^(2) to force target-scale kappa_H^2 W_H^(2) on an indefinite pair, or aggregate the complementary definite/singular/poorly-conditioned pair mass into completed receivers.
